title: Audi Trainee Sales Executive
description:
About the role

A fantastic opportunity is available for a Trainee Sales Executive to join our team at Reading Audi.

As a Sytner Trainee Sales Executive, you will be the first point of contact for customers by initiating conversation and building rapport to excite them about the brand. You will promote the benefits and unique selling points of Audi, accessories and vehicle ownership.

This is a full-time role which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About you

Ideally, you will have previous experience of working in retail and be able to maintain exceptional customer care in a competitive environment.

A passion for delivering excellent customer service is a key attribute of the position, along with a determination to expand your knowledge and inspire others; you will demonstrate enthusiasm and self-motivation to excel in customer service. We offer extensive training to allow you to develop expert knowledge of the Audi.

This role is a fantastic opportunity for those who enjoy meeting people and working for a prestige brand in a highly successful and motivated team.

A full and valid UK driving license would be beneficial / preferred.

When applying for this role please consider that we require candidates to have obtained GCSE grade A -C/9-4 or Functional Skills Level 2 (or equivalent) in the following subjects, English, Maths and 1 other subject as a threshold level of qualification.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please click here.

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on Developing Talent and Building Careers and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
An excellent opportunity has come up with a growing, global company who specialises in business innovation and business change. We are looking for a Business Development Representative to work within a successful sales team.

As the Business Development Representative, you will generate new sales opportunities and add qualified leads to the sales funnel. You will be responsible for prospecting, following up opportunities, and passing on qualified leads to other sales agents who will convert them into new customers.

The Business Development Representative will be responsible for the following:
- Generating leads by cold calling prospective clients
- Follow up on marketing campaigns and engaging with and developing prospects
- Document, track and monitor all leads and activities in the CRM
- Identify opportunities for campaigns
- Nurture relationships with longer term prospects

The successful Business Development Representative will have the following related skills / experience:
- Highly motivated and a self-starter
- Strong desire to meet and exceed quota on a monthly basis
- Comfortable with prospecting and cold calling to a global market
- Excellent telephone manner with confident negotiation skills
- Previous sales experience would be advantageous

title: Sales Executive - Car Leasing
salary_text: £24000 - £50000 per year (+ Commission and great benefits)
description:
Company Overview:

Our client are an award-winning leader in the car and van leasing industry. Thier continued growth and success is driven by strong values of honesty, hard work, and integrity, alongside high-performing individuals and premium customer service.

Position Overview:

If you have developed a successful sales track record, this is your opportunity to turn a healthy pipeline of inbound leads and existing customers into successful deals with private individuals and businesses. There is no cold calling; a strong telephone manner and a highly organised work ethic are essential to drive new deals and achieve uncapped commission potential.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain relationships with inbound leads and existing customers.
- Understand customers' current leasing needs and future plans.
- Provide cost-effective solutions using the bespoke fleet management system.
- Deliver strong and confident telephone interactions, asking the right questions and confirming your understanding of customer needs.
- Collaborate with colleagues to create leasing solutions and maintain premium customer service.
- Manage all necessary administration elements, including order details, finances, delivery, and other timescales.

Requirements:
- Proven sales experience, preferably in the automotive sector; leasing experience is a bonus.
- Strong telephone manner and excellent communication skills.
- Highly organised with great attention to detail.
- Ability to juggle priorities and maintain a high level of customer service.
- Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in other departments.

Benefits:
- Uncapped commission potential.
- 24 days' holiday (plus bank holidays), increasing with service to a maximum of 30 days.
- Stakeholder pension.
- Optional healthcare.
- Car salary sacrifice scheme.
- Amazing team-building events.
- Beautiful offices near train station and close to shops.
- Comprehensive training and development opportunities.

title: Account Manager - MSP / IT
description:
Job Title: Account Manager

Location: Hybrid / Newbury with Client travel typically twice per week

Salary: Competitive + Commission

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

About the role:

Netteam tX is seeking a commercially focused Account Manager to retain and grow a portfolio of approximately 30 existing small and mid-sized clients.

You will own the commercial client relationship, develop a detailed understanding of each organisation, and identify opportunities to provide additional value through Netteam tX products and services. Your primary objectives will be to achieve an individual growth target from within the existing client portfolio, retain contract renewals, and maintain strong client satisfaction.

Responsibilities:

Client relationship management
- Own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of approximately 30 existing clients.
- Build trusted relationships with business owners, senior decision-makers, and other key stakeholders.
- Develop a strong understanding of each client organisation, including priorities, challenges, budgets, and future plans.
- Maintain a structured schedule of client meetings, service reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
- Act as the principal commercial contact and point of coordination between clients and Netteam tX.
- Gather structured client feedback, coordinate appropriate actions, and maintain an accurate account plan for every assigned client.

Existing-account growth
- Achieve an individual target based on incremental business generated from the existing client portfolio.
- Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities based on genuine client needs and business objectives.
- Build and maintain a qualified account-growth pipeline.
- Work with technical and commercial specialists to develop appropriate solutions and proposals.
- Lead commercial conversations relating to additional products, services, projects, and licensing.
- Maintain accurate forecasts and provide regular performance updates to the Commercial Director.

Renewals and retention
- Take ownership of the commercial renewal process across the assigned portfolio.
- Maintain an accurate schedule of contract, service, and licensing renewal dates.
- Start renewal conversations early enough to understand client intentions, risks, and changing requirements.
- Coordinate internal input for renewal proposals and commercial reviews.
- Identify renewal risks and raise them promptly with the Commercial Director.

Strategic client engagement
- Lead quarterly strategic reviews, presenting evidence from Netteam systems, the external landscape and the client's aspirations to deliver strategic roadmap led recommendations.
- Help clients connect technology decisions with wider business objectives.
- Discuss technology investments in terms of business value, cost, risk, and operational impact.
- Coordinate technical specialists when detailed advice, assessments, or solution designs are required.
- Maintain sufficient awareness of cloud services, cybersecurity, networking, modern workplace technology, artificial intelligence, and automation to recognise relevant opportunities.
- Translate technical recommendations into clear business and commercial language.

Service liaison and escalation
- Act as the commercial liaison between clients and the Netteam tX service organisation.
- Review service performance and recurring issues during regular client meetings.
- Ensure client concerns are recorded and directed to the appropriate internal team.
- Escalate material service concerns to the Director of Service.
- Keep clients appropriately informed while service issues are being investigated or resolved.

CRM, reporting, and forecasting
- Maintain accurate client, opportunity, renewal, and activity records within the CRM system.
- Produce reliable forecasts against the individual existing-account growth target.
- Record agreed client actions and ensure commitments are followed through.
- Use commercial and client data to identify renewal risks and growth opportunities.
- Report on pipeline, renewals, account performance, and client feedback to the Commercial Director.

Security and compliance awareness
- Maintain a working awareness of cybersecurity, data protection, and information-security principles.
- Recognise potential client risks and involve the appropriate Netteam tX specialists.
- Follow company governance, commercial, data-protection, and information-security processes.
- Ensure commercial commitments are properly documented and internally approved.

About you:

Experience and attributes:

Essential experience:
- Successful account-management experience within an MSP, technology provider.
- A strong record of growing existing client accounts and achieving individual commercial targets.
- Experience managing contract and service renewals and converting cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
- Confidence engaging business owners and senior decision-makers.
- Commercial awareness and the ability to relate technology investments to business outcomes.
- Experience coordinating internal service, technical, project, and commercial teams.
- Ability to manage client concerns and maintain confidence during service issues.
- Experience using a CRM system to manage activity, opportunities, renewals, and forecasts.
- Strong written, verbal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
- Willingness to travel to client sites, typically twice per week.

Desirable experience:
- Experience managing a portfolio of small and mid-sized organisations.
- Awareness of ITIL, ISMS, ISO 27001, or similar service and security frameworks.
- Detailed solutions-architecture knowledge and hands-on engineering experience are not required.

In line with our recruitment policy and client expectation, some roles will be subject to a basic DBS disclosure.

Please click on the APPLY button to send your CV and Cover Letter for this role.

Candidates with experience of: IT Account Manager / B2 B IT Sales Executive, Client Relationship Manager - MSP / Tech, Managed Services Account Manager, MSP Sales Account Manager, Client Success Manager may also be considered for this role.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
We are seeking a proactive and relationship-driven Customer Success Manager to join our client's team. You will be responsible for nurturing strong, long-term relationships with clients and strategic partners, ensuring high levels of satisfaction, engagement, and retention.

As the CSM, you will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers, managing complex enquiries, and identifying opportunities to expand account value through up sell and cross-sell initiatives.

If you possess a customer-first mindset, excellent communication skills, and a track record of effectively managing multi-account portfolios, we would love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:
- Serve as the primary point of contact for customer enquiries, escalations, and ongoing support.
- Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with customers and key partners. Understanding client goals to ensure services deliver maximum value and satisfaction.
- Guide new customers seamlessly through the on boarding journey. Delivering customer training, live demos, and feature walkthroughs tailored to user needs.
- Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews to capture client feedback and drive continuous satisfaction.
- Establish and nurture collaborative relationships with external service providers, vendors, and strategic partners
- Coordinate with third-party partners and internal operations teams to resolve complex account issues efficiently.
- Partner with the Sales team to support renewal strategies.
- Identify up sell, cross-sell, and account expansion opportunities, as well as lead win-back strategies for legacy accounts.

What we are looking for:
- Proven experience in a similar Customer Service/Success position.
- Passion for delivering exceptional client experiences and solving complex problems.
- Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritise tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Details:
- Title: Customer Success Manager
- Salary: 26,000 - 32,000 DOE
- Location: Newbury, fully office-based
